name: suspension strap reverse crunch
description: A reverse crunch from a high plank with the feet in suspension straps, bringing the knees and pelvis toward the chest.
instructions: Put both feet in the suspension straps and set a high plank with your hands below your shoulders.
Keep your shoulders strong and your hips level before drawing the knees in.
Brace your abdomen and draw your knees toward your chest, letting the pelvis curl slightly under.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to a straight plank without letting the lower back sag.
